## Description

Record ADR-011: native apps with Expo, two store apps (staff app for doctors and front desk; patient app in indigo) in a `mobile/` pnpm workspace sharing tokens, i18n messages, API contracts and `domain/` + `services/` code with `web/`. Decide token auth for native clients (OIDC code + PKCE with secure-store; the web BFF cookie is not reused), what may be stored on the device (nothing but tokens, device key and an encrypted offline queue), push payload rule, EAS Update scope, and the store-account owner. Update the data map and threat model for devices.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the ADR, when it is accepted, then it names the two apps, the repo folders, the auth flow and the on-device storage rule.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the threat model, when it is reviewed, then lost phone, shared phone, screenshot, push preview and offline queue each have a control.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the data map, when it is updated, then device storage and push payloads are listed with their classification.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
